title: Make retained evidence hashes checkout-portable
requires: Any development host; Windows CRLF checkout for regression verification
scope: Make the retained F6-07, F6-09 and F6-10 text-evidence integrity checks independent of Git checkout line endings without changing pinned artifacts, recorded hashes or binary hashing semantics.
acceptance: Use one shared canonical text hashing rule that normalizes CRLF to LF while retaining lone carriage returns and every other byte; archives and binary artifacts remain byte-exact.
Add focused regression coverage proving LF and CRLF text hash identically while non-line-ending text and binary changes remain visible.
Pass the F6-07, F6-09 and F6-10 evidence tests plus the full roadmap suite on Windows without rewriting any retained evidence or stored hash.
